description: Book a service offered by a human using the account’s configured funding rail. Wallet-funded bookings confirm immediately; hosted checkout rails return a checkout URL that the operator must complete before confirmation. Requires RENTAHUMAN_API_KEY to be set.

date.description: The date for the booking (YYYY-MM-DD format)

humanId.description: The unique ID of the human offering the service
humanId.title: minLength(1)

serviceId.description: The unique ID of the service to book

startTime.description: The start time for the booking (HH:mm format)

name: book_service
